RYDIA_SUMMON.title: Summon
RYDIA_SUMMON.description:
At 100 Summon, gain [gold]Eidolon Resonance[/gold].

While you have [gold]Eidolon Resonance[/gold], Eidolon cards deal double damage and apply additional effects. Playing an [gold]Eidolon[/gold] card consumes it.

Gain 5 Summon at the start of your turn.
Gain 3 Summon whenever you play an Attack.
Gain 6 Summon whenever you play an Eidolon card.
RYDIA_EIDOLON.title: Eidolon
RYDIA_EIDOLON.description: Gain 6 [gold]Summon[/gold] when you play this card. During [gold]Eidolon Resonance[/gold], Eidolon cards deal double damage and apply additional effects.
